markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and typical image quality support this [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 99%, InSitu 1%, Normal 0% | Strongly Benign |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 64th percentile | Typical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Benign [F5] | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Strong tubule score, linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Moderately elevated benign stroma score · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest concept term, but failed spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; no clear invasive signal · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so unproven; the leading concept, normal lobules, is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration error is imprecise (ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18); 99% may overstate certainty.
- Cells were sampled in 3 regions only, with insufficient tumor nuclei flagged; focal disease elsewhere is possible.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 10, 11:** Confirm two-layered lobular epithelium; its concept failed the spot check.
2. **Region 8:** Look for atypical ductal cells; pleomorphism and duct-confined scores peak here.
3. **Region 11:** Confirm no stromal invasion; the infiltrating-stroma score peaks here.
